attacks.message: The Loop King coils tighter — your range stops one step short.

tests.label: Includes n when n is even

hintCards.title: range is exclusive
hintCards.body: `range(1, 5)` yields 1,2,3,4 — the stop value is left out. To include n, use `range(1, n + 1)`.

hintCards.title: Accumulator pattern
hintCards.body: Start at zero outside the loop, add inside it.
